# Energy Shapes — Home Energy Upgrade

> Energy Shapes publishes practical educational guides and tools about heat pumps, heating and cooling systems, insulation, water heaters and home energy improvements.

The website helps homeowners understand equipment choices, installation considerations, cost factors and home energy planning. Its calculators provide illustrative estimates, not guaranteed savings or professional assessments.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.energyshapes.com/): Main website and home energy tools.
- [About](https://www.energyshapes.com/about): Our approach to home energy information.
- [Contact](https://www.energyshapes.com/contact): Contact the website.
